key_points: Two large institutional investors (QRG Capital, State Street) disclosed reduced holdings in SPG, indicating possible downside bias
Options chain listings dominate headlines, but they are routine market activity with little informational content
No earnings, guidance, M&A or regulatory news to shift fundamentals
Recent peer news (Starwood) unrelated to SPG’s core business
Overall sentiment modestly negative but impact on price expected to be limited in the short‑term
